name: plan_series
description: Return an ordered outline for a multi-part blog series: an overall series title/description plus one entry per part.

series_title.description: Reader-facing name for the whole series, without a part number

series_description.description: One-sentence description of what the series covers as a whole

part_number.description: 1-based position of this part in the reading order

title.description: Concrete working title for this part, WITHOUT a 'Part N:' prefix

angle.description: 1-2 sentences on what this part specifically covers and how it differs from the other parts

key_points.description: 3-6 concrete points or sections this part must cover

parts.description: The ordered parts of the series
